visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a green and brown plaid shirt and a grey beanie eats a charcoal-grilled burger patty. The screen is split, showing close-ups of meat sizzling on a wire grill over glowing embers. The restaurant has warm, ambient lighting with wooden accents. (2) A male staff member in a black uniform and cap claps his gloved hands rhythmically behind a large circular counter. In the background, diverse customers are seated around the central cooking area in an industrial-style space. (3) Close-up view of three thick meat patties cooking on the metal grill. Plumes of smoke rise into a large, cylindrical overhead exhaust hood made of sheet metal. (4) A hand touches a digital ordering kiosk screen displaying menu items. The scene shifts to show wooden storage lockers with glass panels for patrons' belongings. (5) A hand holds up a white instructional pamphlet with black illustrations and text. The man in the plaid shirt sits at the counter, picking up a burger patty with chopsticks from a ceramic bowl of rice. (6) A hand holds a small plastic bottle of brown liquid, shaking it and pouring it over a side dish of white grated radish. Another hand uses a metallic salt grinder over a plate of condiments. (7) A white egg is held up and cracked into a small bowl. The burger patty is dipped into the bright yellow egg yolk. The person eats kimchi and mixes the egg into the rice. (8) Intense orange flames flare up from the charcoal grill as meat is flipped. Staff members use large scoops to transfer white rice from traditional iron pots into ceramic bowls. (9) Light-colored beer is poured from a brown bottle into a clear glass. The main character toasts to the camera, smiling and giving a thumbs-up gesture. A red location pin overlay appears at the bottom.
